newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Four die in freezing Slovenia.
newsitem.headline: Four die in freezing Slovenia.

text.p: Four Slovenians froze to death over the Christmas and New Year holidays with thousands of homes across the Alpine nation suffering power blackouts due to cold weather, police said on Monday.
Around 20,000 homes were without electricity over the weekend, with some 12,000 still without power on Monday after damage to power lines caused by fallen trees.

"We cannot yet estimate the damage or say when it will be repaired, as our teams have to struggle through snowy woods before getting to the damaged areas," Brane Janic, a spokesman for electricity distributor Elektro Slovenija, said.
But the freezing temperatures reduced the number of traffic accidents as people stayed at home during the holidays and shunned perilous roads, police said.
The Christmas and New Year deep freeze in Europe killed scores of people across the continent and caused road, rail, air and shipping chaos.
